description: This file defines authentication and authorization logic using FastAPI, including dependency functions to retrieve user context, load permissions from the database, and enforce permissions. It also contains data structures for handling authenticated request information.

classes.name: AuthContext
classes.description: Data class that encapsulates the authenticated user context, including user info, organization ID, optional workspace ID, and permissions set.

methods.name: Set[str] _load_user_permissions(session: AsyncSession, user_id: uuid.UUID)
methods.description: Asynchronously loads user permissions by querying related tables in the database.

methods.name: HTTPException _http_unauthorized(detail: str = "Not authenticated")
methods.description: Helper function to generate a 401 Unauthorized HTTPException.

methods.name: HTTPException _http_forbidden(detail: str = "Not authorized")
methods.description: Helper function to generate a 403 Forbidden HTTPException.

methods.name: User _get_user_by_id(session: AsyncSession, user_id: uuid.UUID)
methods.description: Fetches a User object from the database by user ID, ensuring the user is active.

methods.name: AuthContext get_auth_context( credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security_scheme), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), x_organization_id: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-Organization-Id"), x_workspace_id: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-Workspace-Id"), )
methods.description: Main function to authenticate incoming requests, decode JWT tokens, load user info, permissions, and tenancy details, returning an AuthContext object.

methods.name: require_permission(permission: str)
methods.description: Factory function that creates dependencies to enforce specific permissions in request handlers.

ctags.name: get_auth_context
ctags.signature: ( credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security_scheme), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), x_organization_id: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-Organization-Id"), x_workspace_id: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-Workspace-Id"), )
